source_refs: document/架構重整/01_規格基線/28_驗證情境與測試資料正式規格.md#PERF-02
root_facts: An in-process FastAPI request, fixed handler latency samples and a typed system-status response fixture.
forbidden_direct_seed: performance aggregate, UI display state, cache-control result or slow-request alert
commands: Issue query and mutation requests through performance middleware.
Record fixed latency samples, retrieve the typed performance endpoint and decode it through the UI client.
Exercise cache-key, payload-budget, single-flight and stale-response policies.
expected: Query responses expose ephemeral timing headers; mutations are no-store.
The in-memory aggregate uses fixed latency buckets without request logs and is information-only in the System Status UI.
Typed UI client rejects malformed payloads and policy guards reject stale or duplicate requests.
This scenario does not measure browser event-to-paint latency or create a performance alert.

runner: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -W error tests\test_api_performance_middleware.py tests\test_performance_snapshot.py tests\test_system_status_ui.py tests\test_system_status_router.py tests\test_system_status_api_client.py tests\test_performance_policies.py
